params.prompt: Photorealistic photograph, straight-on. The open sliding service window of a red-painted walk-up food stand in Los Angeles in bright afternoon sun, strings of colorful cut-paper papel picado banners hanging above, a red brick-tile base below the counter. On the empty wooden counter: a small silver service bell and a blank paper order ticket clipped to the frame. Warm, inviting, crisp detail, shallow depth of field on the counter. No food, no text, no logos, no signage, no people, no hands.
